Players Committee card image of [[I'm Getting Pretty Good At This (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E3), game text: “If Finn and either Poe or Rey are in a battle together, you may add two battle destiny. OR Deploy Finn aboard any starship or vehicle from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/imgettingprettygoodatthis.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/649630ff80dd241d266f2ee5b566324d6fb68448 649630f] (27 August 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
